body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-scripts-ci finding 4). scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs is 336 lines of code that is un-wired (not in scripts/run-tests.mjs SEGMENTS, not in any workflow, not called from any test). It fails with exit 2 due to legacy ticket store path expectations.

Retire scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs and clean up its references:
1. Delete scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs.
2. In apps/docs/lib/integration-facts.mjs, update the OpenCode operate command line from 'node scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs .' to 'npm test --workspace=@adlc/opencode'.
3. In docs/integrations/opencode.md and apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/opencode.mdx, update the offline contract command reference.
4. In scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs, remove references to opencode-install-smoke.mjs in comments.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- AC1 scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs is deleted.
- AC2 node --test apps/docs/test/*.test.mjs passes all tests.
- AC3 git grep opencode-install-smoke outside git history returns 0 matches.
- AC4 scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs remains untouched (rail-freeze clean).
- AC5 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: chore(scripts): retire dead opencode-install-smoke and update doc references
